(docs/twin_validation/wave2_6_unit_test_contract.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program;

Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: frontend/axis1_selection.py -- the Axis-1 mechanism-selection layer: three frozen
dataclasses (Axis1MechanismSelection / Axis1MechanismSelectionPlan / Axis1SelectionLayer) whose
load-bearing __post_init__ coerces + validates fields and each expose a to_manifest; the plan
adds by_kind + require_kind; the schedule-order partition function
axis1_selection_layers_in_schedule_order (+ flatten_axis1_selection_layers +
axis1_selection_partition_manifest); and the two selectors build_axis1_g2_selection_plan /
build_axis1_schedule_selection_plan that dispatch over a private-helper bank
(_cz_exact_zero_selections / _generic_*_selections / _drive_zz_selections / _selection_from_substep
/ _static_zz_* / _normal_pair / ...). The module imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb (dataclasses +
sibling frontend imports: analog_schedule / axis1_context / metadata_guard), so EVERY public unit
is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the AST reconcile
refuses any gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module).
FIFTEEN public units (AST reconcile _public_units_in_module: top-level public defs + every public
method of a top-level class -- including read-only @property methods participants/selection_ids --
plus the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder of each frozen dataclass). The many module-level private
helpers (_cz_exact_zero_selections / _generic_drive_selections / _generic_two_qubit_layer_cluster_
selections / _generic_cz_joint_channel_selections / _generic_frontend_two_qubit_joint_channel_
selections / _generic_idle_cluster_selections / _generic_idle_joint_channel_selections /
_generic_readout_cluster_selections / _generic_readout_joint_channel_selections / _drive_zz_
selections / _static_pairs_within_support / _selection_from_substep / _selection_with_lindblad_
context / _fsim_residual_primitives_for_selection / _append_unique / _validate_drive_slots /
_static_zz_pairs / _static_zz_calibrations / _unsupported_static_cluster_substep_ids /
_operation_pair_participants(_ordered) / _two_qubit_operation_pairs / _has_two_qubit_gate /
_normal_pair) are NOT units (not reconciled/scored) but ARE exercised + mutation-covered through
the two public build_* selectors (mutmut is coverage-guided). The unit set:
* 3 dataclass __post_init__: Axis1MechanismSelection / Axis1MechanismSelectionPlan /
Axis1SelectionLayer.
* 4 dataclass to_manifest: Axis1MechanismSelection / Axis1MechanismSelectionPlan /
Axis1SelectionLayer (Axis1MechanismSelectionPlan.to_manifest is the 4th).
* Axis1MechanismSelectionPlan.by_kind / require_kind.
* Axis1SelectionLayer.participants / selection_ids (read-only properties).
* axis1_selection_layers_in_schedule_order / flatten_axis1_selection_layers /
axis1_selection_partition_manifest.
* build_axis1_g2_selection_plan / build_axis1_schedule_selection_plan.
CPU discipline. Every unit runs on plain-Python dataclass construction + CircuitIR compilation
(circuit_ir_to_substep_schedule -- no torch, no simulator dynamics), so the tests are fast +
deterministic.
L2 DISCIPLINE (100% coverage != discrimination). The two build_* selectors hard-code, per row, the
row_kind / primitive_names / mechanism_pair / context_mechanisms / reason / coupling_edges. The
core discriminator is a per-row_kind BATTERY (test_L0_schedule_plan_rowkind_battery) that compiles
a curated circuit for each of the 20 supported row_kinds + the 2 G2 rows and pins the resulting
selection's EXACT helper-chosen fields (kills the row_kind/primitive/mechanism/context/reason/edge
string+tuple mutants and the branch that selected the row), plus exact to_manifest dicts on the
H / I-with-arg / M-with-basis-keys / CZ / coupling-edge-present operation shapes. Skip/cluster
arithmetic (max-support constants, cross-window, active-pair, multi-pair loops, unsupported-static)
is pinned by 6q-support + 4q-crosswindow + cx-active-pair cases.
RAISING-GUARD ROUTE COVERAGE + REACHABILITY (the D13/D18 lesson): every validation raise in
Axis1MechanismSelection.__post_init__ (participant empty/duplicate; coupling-edge len!=2;
_normal_pair equal endpoints; non-unique edges; edge-not-contained; edges-only-valid-for-zz/pair;
zz-cluster-requires-edges; active-pair-edges-must-equal-pair; unsupported row_kind; no-primitive;
mechanism_pair-len; dt-bracket) is tripped by DIRECT construction with the EXACT message via
str(excinfo.value)==...  The axis1_selection_layers_in_schedule_order guards (unknown-substep;
empty-participant; same-substep overlap) are tripped through BOTH the build_* partition path AND a
hand-built-selection path, and -- because the message embeds consumer_name -- with a NON-default
consumer_name too. The empty-participant guard is reachable ONLY by forcing an already-built
selection's participant to () via object.__setattr__ (the __post_init__ forbids it at
construction) -- an explicit reachability probe, mirroring the analog_schedule seal probe.
DEAD-DEFENSIVE BRANCHES, PROBED NOT ASSUMED (2 line/branch exemptions on
Axis1MechanismSelection.__post_init__):
* line 153 `if len(edge) != 2 or edge[0] == edge[1]:` -- every coupling edge is normalized
through _normal_pair(*edge) (line 149) BEFORE this loop; _normal_pair returns a distinct
2-tuple (a<b) or raises 'Axis-1 mechanism-selection pair must contain distinct qubits'. So by
line 152 every `edge` in `edges` is a 2-tuple of distinct ints -> this re-check can NEVER be
True. PROVEN by test_L0_selection_post_init_coupling_edge_guards: the equal-endpoint route
raises _normal_pair's message (NOT this line's 'invalid Axis-1 coupling edge'), and the
len!=2 route is caught by the earlier raw-edge loop (line 147). Its True->raise arc is dead;
the containment check on line 155 (the REACHABLE guard) is separately tripped.
* line 181 `if len(participant) < 2:` (inside the zz-cluster block) -- an edge that survives
the containment check (line 155) has TWO distinct endpoints, both in participant_set, so a
zz-cluster row with a valid edge always has >= 2 distinct participants (duplicates already
raised at line 129). So this guard's True->raise arc is dead. PROVEN by
test_L0_selection_post_init_zz_cluster_two_qubit_participant_ok (the minimal 2-participant
zz-cluster is valid) + ..._requires_edges (the no-edge route raises earlier at line 178).
Both are genuine equivalents / src-cleanup candidates (NOT edited here); mutmut still KILLS most
mutants on these lines because flipping the dead guard makes it fire on the many REACHABLE
valid-edge / valid-zz-cluster selections the tests build.
NO out_of_scope: every public unit is CPU-pure and every REACHABLE guard is tripped through a
constructor/selector route (checked, not assumed).
L2 MUTATION (kill_rate 0.9779 >= 0.90 bar; 1679/1717 killed, 38 survivors). Option-A applied the
user-APPROVED src de-dup: Axis1MechanismSelection.__post_init__ dropped the REDUNDANT
str(x).upper() on primitive_names / mechanism_pair / context_mechanisms / operation_names
(every construction site -- the two axis1_selection helpers + axis1_carrier_program:775 -- passes
ALL-CAPS literals, and the carrier site uppercases operation_names itself, so the coercion
normalized nothing) and now coerces with str(x) only. Before the de-dup ~189 (of ~1717) case-swap
mutants of the ALL-CAPS helper literals (e.g. ('ZZ',...) -> ('zz',...)) were MASKED byte-identical
by that re-uppercasing; dropping it un-masks them and the per-row_kind battery's exact-case field
pins (test_L0_schedule_plan_rowkind_battery + the to_manifest / G2 pins) KILL them. Seven further
workflow-verified reachable helper-bank gaps were then closed by tests (each with a constructed
reaching input, orig-vs-mutant diffed -- NOT assumed): _unsupported_static_cluster_substep_ids
max_support=None (TypeError on len>None, every kind reached via a from_spec=False canonical
schedule); _operation_pair_participants_ordered repeated-pair + odd-count raises (reached only
when a >5-support two-qubit substep skips the layer-cluster helper's _normal_pair pre-check);
axis1_selection_layers_in_schedule_order sorted(grouped, key=None) / key=lambda->None (a fake
schedule whose substep_id string order reverses its order_index); _static_pairs_within_support
pair[0]->pair[1] (a static edge whose MAX endpoint is in support but MIN is not);
_generic_idle_joint_channel_selections `<2 or %2`->`and` (a 7-qubit ODD over-cap idle indexes
past the tuple); and the multi-active-no-idle `>MAX`->`>=MAX` support cap at support==5.
The 38 residual survivors are ALL PROVABLY-EQUIVALENT (verified, not hand-waved):
* 25 loop-early-exit continue->break mutants on terminal / effectively-single-iteration
branches -- the reachable ones are killed by the grand-tour / multi-producer / branch-double
break battery; these remaining ones have no later same-loop iteration that appends.
* getattr(schedule, 'static_zz_couplings'/'static_zz_calibrations', ()/{}) default mutants are
dead: a real SubstepSchedule always carries the attribute, so the default is never used.
* _normal_pair `a < b` -> `a <= b` is preempted by its own a==b raise.
* build_axis1_g2_selection_plan _has_two_qubit_gate(schedule, 'CX') -> 'cx' is a no-op because
_has_two_qubit_gate uppercases its name argument (str(name).upper()).
* the four AXIS1_*_CLUSTER_MAX_SUPPORT constants are ALL 5, so _unsupported_static_cluster_
substep_ids' one_qubit kind-literal string mutants are redundant (the one-qubit selector's
own cap already skips oversized one-qubit substeps) and its `>max_support`->`>=` mutant is
invisible at the only differing point (support==5 is always <=5 and thus already clustered,
so it is in the skip set regardless).
* the both-empty / defensive `or`->`and` guard mutants in _generic_readout_cluster_selections
(`not measured or not visible_support`), _generic_readout_joint_channel_selections
(`kind != 'measurement' or dt is None`; non-measurement ops still carry a basis != 'Z' that
the later any(...) filters), and _drive_zz_selections (a 1q substep without idle has an empty
inner loop and slots always {drive,idle,spectator}) produce byte-identical output.
The 15 reconciled PUBLIC units are covered at L0 100% stmt+branch + L1; the residual survivors
all live in the private helper bank (not reconciled units).
